options.name: terminal-window loss weighting
options.change: Increase loss weight only for the final 10-15% of each demonstration window, preserving state/action definitions and sampler.
risks: requires a fresh isolated checkpoint family

options.name: release-transition auxiliary weighting
options.change: Weight frames around the demonstrated gripper transition while leaving all other frames unchanged.
pros: more localized than full terminal weighting
risks: does not directly fix spatial placement error

options.name: no new training; protocol expansion
options.change: Expand benchmark evaluation across more tasks/initializations before changing the objective.
risks: does not address the already-repeated task-0 failure

recommendation.reason: The existing evidence most directly implicates temporal/release-window supervision; A is the smallest isolated change that tests this without repeating failed sampler, gripper, or horizon interventions.
preconditions: explicit strict benchmark evaluation after training
